arguments.prompt: Audit the module boundaries in the checked-out repository and write every finding to findings.json at the workspace root, i.e. one level above repo/, never inside the repository. Create that file yourself; do not only print the findings to stdout. Use JSON with a stable shape: { "findings": [ { "file": "<repo-relative path>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "note": "<one sentence>" } ] }. Read repo/ for the code, but write findings.json and any long log under .swarmforge/artifacts/ so nothing lands inside the repository. This task commits nothing and pushes nothing, so a file inside repo/ would be untracked repository dirt the operator has to clean up. Return the structured result; do not put the findings in the summary.
